entries.1c93a9f54475b3f0: A service providing the DX tool for building workplaces "Work Design Platform" and the organizational improvement survey "Kokoel". "Work Design Platform" analyzes workplaces from three perspectives, namely space occupancy rate analysis, cost simulation and employee satisfaction survey, and supports visualization of corporate challenges and building of optimal workplaces. "Kokoel" is a survey that consists of 141 questions, assesses the status of mental, physical and engagement aspects, performs factor analysis, and conducts organizational analysis. The amount is not separately disclosed.
